in_arabic.name: رويس
in_arabic.long_meaning: الرويس: أصل الكلمة من الحرف (ر) و (و) و (س) و (ء) بمعنى الإشراف و الرأفة و الرعاية، و هو اسم لعبد الله بن مسعود الذي عُرف بهذا اللقب بسبب رحلته مع النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، و هو أحد أشهر الصحابة و المشاهير في الإسلام، و يُعتبر رمزًا للرعاية و الإشراف العادلين في الإسلام

in_urdu.name: رویس
in_urdu.meaning: ادارہ اور مدد اور دیکھ بھال
in_urdu.long_meaning: رویس: اس نام کا اورثہ Arabic لفظ (ر)۔ (و)۔ (س)۔ (ء) سے لیا گیا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے ادارہ اور مدد اور دیکھ بھال، اور یہ نام ان شخص کے لیے مخصوص ہے جو اپنے کاموں میں نیک اور مددگار ہو۔ اس نام کی اہمیت کے حوالے سے، رویس نام سے مشہور صحابی نے اپنے آپ کو نبی اکرم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کے ساتھ ہمیشہ ان کے ساتھ رہنا ہی سمجھا۔

in_hindi.name: रुवायस
in_hindi.long_meaning: रुवायस: इस नाम का मूल अर्थ है प्रबंधन और सहायता और देखभाल, और यह नाम उन व्यक्ति के लिए उपयुक्त है जो अपने काम में नेक और सहायक हो। इस नाम की महत्ता के संदर्भ में, रुवायस नाम से प्रसिद्ध साथी ने अपने आप को नबी अक्रम सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम के साथ हमेशा उनके साथ रहना ही समझा।

in_pashto.name: رویس
in_pashto.long_meaning: رویس: دا نوم په Arabيکي ځانګړي څرنګوالي لري چې د (ر) او (و) او (س) او (ء) پر بنسټ دی چې د څارنه او پوځي په مانا دی، دا نوم هغو وختونو لپاره چمتکاريږي کله چې څوک په څارنه او پوځي کړنو کې ناکام شي، دا نوم د افغانانو او پښتنو د اسلامي تقليد کې يو څرنګوالي لري.

in_english.name: Ruwais
in_english.long_meaning: Ruwais: This name is derived from the Arabic roots (R) and (W) and (S) and (A) meaning care and compassion and guardianship. This name is suitable for those who show care and compassion and guardianship in their work and life. In the context of Islamic tradition, the name Ruwais is associated with a companion of the Prophet Muhammad who was known for his care and compassion for the Prophet and his companions.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ruwais has its roots in the Arabic language, which translates to "the one who is from a small desert place." This name can be associated with the nomadic lifestyle, common in early Islamic history. Ruwais can refer to individuals who originate from or have a deep connection to desert regions in various parts of the Islamic world, including the Arabian Peninsula and the Sahara desert. This name reflects the rich cultural heritage of desert-dwelling communities who have been able to thrive and maintain their traditions despite the harsh environmental conditions.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, deserts are often considered places of solitude and reflection. Prophet Muhammad (Peace Be Upon Him) would retreat to the desert several times during his life for reflection and contemplation. The spiritual significance of the name Ruwais can be linked to this tradition, suggesting that the person bearing this name has a deep connection to spiritual practices, introspection, and self-reflection. Furthermore, it may indicate that the person holds perseverance, resilience, and adaptability in facing the challenges of life, as is characteristic of desert-dwelling communities. Therefore, the name Ruwais holds both cultural significance as a reference to the origins of the individual, as well as spiritual significance as an indicator of their connection to the spiritual and introspective aspects of Islamic tradition.

historical_references.reference: Ruwais is mentioned in the 11th century book 'Al-Aqd al-Farid' by the Persian scholar Al-Biruni as a city in the Indian subcontinent.
historical_references.context: Al-Biruni was a Persian scholar and scientist, born in Khwarazm (present-day Uzbekistan). He wrote extensively on various subjects including history, mathematics, astronomy, and philosophy. In his book 'Al-Aqd al-Farid', he mentions Ruwais as a city in the Indian subcontinent.
